title: baio wiring output — logic block v1
description: The wiring builder OUTPUT contract: one logic BLOCK answering one drawn arrow (or a re-run over an arrow bundle). Two-stage pipeline, mirroring the shapes pipeline: Gemini ANALYZES the arrow neighborhood (what the endpoints are, spatial context) and reports intent; Claude Haiku WRITES the block body against this schema. A block is a stateless function: it reads named cells (inputs), runs on a trigger, and produces one output whose TYPE carries the meaning — `data` writes a cell, `page` navigates (the href). State never lives in the block; it lives in cells. Like the shapes contract the block carries NO coordinates and NO element geometry — the arrow's endpoints are resolved deterministically by the existing proximity/geometry pass; the model contributes only semantics (inputs, trigger, body, output). This is a NEW-feature contract (not part of the FreeSolo shapes training waves), consumed by the /api/wire validator and the reactive runtime; there is no training-parity obligation yet. schema_version is the literal "logic-1.0": contract revision. See shared/schemas/README.md.
